transcript_segments.text: Too much coming in at once It just right too close to touch
Every layer speaking loud No space left inside the crowd
Every detail pulls me wide Threads unravel from inside
Tiny signals magnified No air left for me too
Hide I'm at the world in shifting lines Patterns stacking miss a line
Every flicker every tone demands a place Inside my bones I try to hold it
All in place But it accelerates And something soft begins to fall
Not silence, just let's have it all Turn the cut off slowly down
Let the edges lose their sound What will shock begins to bend into something I can stand
Not erasing, just refine Genital shapes inside my mind
I don't need it all to stay Just enough to find my way
What was piercing turns to glow When I let the brightness go
No remote, just re-arranged Frequency's begin to change
Every search that pulled me tight Softens under the moonlight
I can feel the signal breeze When I choose what I receive it isn't gone
It's just controlled A quiet, a curva-soft, a frame-same world, different games
Turn the cut off slowly down Let the edges lose their sound
What will shock begins to bend into something I can stand
Not erasing, just refine Genital shapes inside my mind
I don't need it all to stay Just enough to find my way
There's nothing wrong with the way I feel Just too much arriving all at once
What if calm isn't empty But selected What if peace isn't absence but intention
Now the world moves at my pace Rounded corners Open space I can follow I can stay without needing to escape
Every color still exists Just without the sharpened twist I can rest inside the flow of a range I finally know not overwhelm
Just to wear Turn the cut off all the way to where I can safely stay
Not too distant, not too near Just a feel that feels sincere
I don't lose what's real to me I just shape what I can see
In the quiet I create I can finally integrate Soft and lines steady breath
Nothing missing Nothing left Just a signal I can't just
held in warmth Instead of fresh
